title: How Many Conference Titles Has Oklahoma Won? 50, Most in FBS
question: How many conference championships has Oklahoma football won?
answer: Oklahoma has won 50 football conference championships, shared titles included, the most of any FBS program through the 2025 season. The total includes 33 in the Big Six/Seven/Eight lineage and 14 in the Big 12.
summary: Oklahoma owns 50 football conference titles, the most in FBS, including 14 Big 12 crowns and a 14-year Big Eight streak. Here is the full breakdown.
body: No FBS program has won more conference championships than Oklahoma. Counting shared titles, the Sooners have 50, ahead of Nebraska (46), Michigan (45), Ohio State (39) and USC (37) in ESPN's count after the 2025 regular season.

The earliest crowns came in the Southwest Conference in 1915 and 1918, followed by a Missouri Valley title in 1920. The bulk of the total, 33 championships, came in the Big Six, Big Seven and Big Eight lineage between 1938 and 1987.

That stretch includes the most dominant run in the program's history: 14 straight league titles from 1946 through 1959, one under Jim Tatum and 13 under Bud Wilkinson. Later Sooners teams added nine in a row from 1972 to 1980 and four straight from 1984 to 1987.

The Big 12 era added 14 more, won in 2000, 2002, 2004, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2010, 2012 (shared with Kansas State) and six straight from 2015 to 2020. The last of those came on Dec. 19, 2020, against Iowa State at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas, giving OU 14 titles in the league's first 25 years, 13 outright and one shared.
Oklahoma joined the SEC in 2024 and, through the 2025 season, is still chasing its first title in its new conference, which would be championship number 51.
